summary: Pappas reaffirmed Israel's right to exist, voted for Iron Dome aid, and stated in 2025 he has 'never wavered' in support of Israel. He voted yea on the IHRA Antisemitism Awareness Act and co-sponsored its 2025 re-introduction. Vote for Peace rates him Opposed and Citizens Against AIPAC Corruption spent against him. His 2026 no on the anti-BDS bill and 'present' on the Massie amendment offer limited movement, but his framing pairs Gaza concern with Hamas destruction rather than siege accountability.
